title: Show HN: BetterWispr – Free, open-source dictation for Mac
summary: BetterWispr is a free, open-source dictation application for Mac that provides local speech-to-text functionality, likely leveraging the Whisper AI model for accurate voice recognition without cloud dependencies.
problem_solved: Provides a free, privacy-focused alternative to paid or cloud-based dictation services on Mac.
why_valuable: Enables users to transcribe speech to text locally, ensuring data privacy while eliminating subscription costs for dictation tools.
